pages.title: Electride Crystal
pages.text: A salt in which the negative ions are not atoms at all but bare electrons, sitting in cavities of the lattice like eggs in a carton. It is dark, glossy and conducts strangely, and seems to give up electrons at the slightest provocation.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing electrons into Cherenkov quartz with redstone current, while superfluid helium held the lattice cold and still, I found that some electrons stayed behind in empty sites with no atom to belong to. The Electrolytic Cell had made an electride.
